description.en: Official index of CopyBack plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Install without npm: sources are pinned git commits on GitHub.
description.zh: CopyBack 系列插件的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）官方索引源，无需 npm：所有版本固定在 GitHub 上的发布 commit，来源可核。

plugins.name: dsh-copyback

title.zh: 复制找回 · 剪贴板历史

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: recall, search, pin and re-copy text you copied earlier on this machine. Local-only recorder (127.0.0.1); secret markers from browsers/password managers are skipped. Requires Python 3.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：找回并重新粘贴本机复制过的文字。搜索、按日筛选、置顶收藏；仅本机记录，密码等敏感内容自动跳过。需要 Python 3。

plugins.author: redkiller79; upstream scripts by 飞哥/FeiGe (MIT)
